notes:
What's new

- Compressed SVG (.svgz) previews like any other vector graphic.
- Certificate bundles (.p7b) open the certificate card, and a bundle reports how many certificates it holds.
- A password-protected certificate file (.pfx/.p12) says so instead of showing an empty card.
- Releases are now built with automatic retries, so a virus scanner holding a freshly built file can no longer fail a publish.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.23 - native quick wins (1F, part 1). SVGZ decompresses through the archive backend and loads in the SVG engine; P7B bundles load via CryptQueryObject with certificate counts; password-protected PFX/P12 get a dedicated Password protected state. publish.ps1 retries locked portable-zip and Inno builds. 4 new checks.
